apiContracts: Uses authenticated GET/POST /api/reading-position; owner remains session-derived and expected_revision is server-issued.
dataEntities: Existing reading_positions table only; local storage remains an offline/anonymous cache.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: Reuses the existing reading_positions table; no duplicate schema or numbered migration.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: Anonymous readers retain local-only progress; authenticated readers use the server API when reachable.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Revert the browser integration and served bundle together; the additive API remains backward-compatible.

uiLifecycle.clientBootBehavior: Reader retrieves saved progress after chapter access, restores the current chapter percentage and debounces autosave.
uiLifecycle.servedBundleParity: public/app.js and public/app-17.23.0.js remain byte-identical; service-worker install refreshes its precache.

privacySecurity.authentication: The /api/me session result gates authenticated progress synchronization.
privacySecurity.authorization: All reads and writes are authorized by the Worker API.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: Browser never supplies a user ID; the server derives the owner from the session.
privacySecurity.csrf: Uses same-origin requests and the Worker same-origin write guard.
privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: Debounced writes are subject to server-side rate limits and input bounds.

unit: Reader progress API/client regression assertions in scripts/test-reading-position-api.mjs
integration: Authenticated GET restore and POST autosave wiring
Reconnect discovery after an initially offline load
isolation: No client-supplied account identifier; server API retains cross-account isolation.

stagingSteps: Pass all governed workflows on exact PR head.
Complete real browser tests with multiple accounts and devices before production deployment.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert the reader browser code and matching served bundle; preserve API compatibility.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: No D1 mutation or rollback required.

collisionReview.duplicateRoutes: None; existing reading-position API is reused.
collisionReview.duplicateEntities: None; existing reading_positions table is reused.
collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: public/app.js is experience-shell-owned and changed with ADR-0005.

changeSummary: Connects the reader interface to server-backed progress with debounced revision-guarded autosave and offline fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Server progress restores for the active chapter.
Autosaves are debounced and revision guarded.
A stale write is never blindly replayed.
Canonical and served bundles are byte-identical.
